stories.title: Spokane fires continue to destroy buildings and displace tens of thousands
stories.summary: Since last weekend, the wildfires near Spokane, Wash., have displaced tens of thousands of people and destroyed hundreds of buildings in the state's second-largest city.

stories.title: Ukraine's air defenses are proving to be a weak point
stories.summary: Ukraine's defenses have held the line on most fronts, but there's one glaring weakness -- Russian ballistic missiles. Ukraine is desperately short of U.S.-made Patriot air defense missiles needed to defend against the Russians.

stories.title: TMZ trades Hollywood gossip for Capitol Hill scoops with new D.C. bureau
stories.summary: Over the past 20 years, TMZ has made a name for itself with big scoops on celebrity culture. Now, the popular gossip and news site is taking on Capitol Hill.

stories.title: After years of delays, alleged victims in Camp Lejeune trials may see progress
stories.summary: Judges handling thousands of lawsuits filed by those who believed they were sickened by the water at Camp Lejeune are now pushing for a plan for a mass settlement by October.

stories.title: How Lionel Messi's legend is driving tourism in his hometown
stories.summary: In the city where Lionel Messi grew up, fans are coming to celebrate a legend — and city leaders are hoping they'll discover much more.

stories.title: Conservation project protects stretch of Maine's Magalloway River from development
stories.summary: A unique habitat embedded in a newly conserved 78,000-acre tract of land along Maine's Magalloway {muh-GAL-uh-way} River is beloved by outdoor enthusiasts.
